crossRefs.note: Then he released to them Barabbas, but Jesus he flogged and delivered to be crucified.
Pilate, wishing to please the multitude, released Barabbas to them, and handed over Jesus, when he had flogged him, to…
Pilate decreed that what they asked for should be done.

people.name: Jesus
people.line: The Son of God and Savior of the world.

translations.web: So then he delivered him to them to be crucified. So they took Jesus and led him away.
translations.bsb: Then Pilate handed Jesus over to be crucified, and the soldiers took Him away.
translations.kjv: Then delivered he him therefore unto them to be crucified. And they took Jesus, and led him away.
translations.asv: Then therefore he delivered him unto them to be crucified.
